definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happens many times or with notable frequency. Slightly literary or formal in tone compared to everyday alternatives.

examples.japanese: {再々|さいさい}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直|なお}らない→直る：00735_naoru⟧。
examples.english: I warned them again and again, but they won't change.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再々|さいさい}⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げられている→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧。
examples.english: This issue has been brought up repeatedly.

examples.japanese: {再々|さいさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧にもかかわらず、お⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただけません→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧でした。
examples.english: Despite our repeated contacts, we did not receive a reply.

notes:
Formed by repeating ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again). Used in both written and spoken Japanese but has a somewhat formal or stiff nuance. Often appears in complaints, warnings, or business contexts where repeated occurrences are being emphasized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再々|さいさい}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: warn repeatedly
- {再々|さいさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: repeated demands
- {再々|さいさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって: on numerous occasions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many times — the most common everyday equivalent
- {度々|たびたび}: often; frequently — similar formality level, slightly softer
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧: repeatedly — emphasizes the repetitive action itself
- {重|かさ}ね{重|がさ}ね: time after time — very formal, used in letters and speeches
